cards.card_text: Samson answers them with a farm picture: "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle!"
cards.verse_text: Before sunset on the seventh day, the men of the city said to Samson: “What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?” So he said to them: “If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle!”
